caption: The mode string of notes.txt after chmod 754. The three shaded triads are owner, group and other; the numbers under each position add to 7, 5 and 4, which is the octal 754.

spec.title: chmod 754 on notes.txt: - rwx r-x r--
spec.aria: An array of the ten mode characters with the octal value of each r, w and x position written below it, adding to 754.
